name: Bluefors Oy
description: Bluefors is a world-leading manufacturer of ultra-low temperature measurement systems and cryogenic dilution refrigerators. The company provides critical cryogenic infrastructure for quantum computing systems, enabling quantum processors to operate at the near-absolute-zero temperatures required for quantum coherence. Bluefors systems are used by quantum computing companies and research institutions globally.

products.name: Dilution Refrigerator Systems
products.description: Cryogenic cooling platforms reaching millikelvin temperatures for superconducting quantum processors

products.name: KIDE Cryogenic Platform
products.description: Next-generation modular cryogenic measurement system designed for scalable quantum computing infrastructure

news.title: Bluefors joins Chicago Quantum Exchange and opens Lab Service facility at UChicago
news.excerpt: Bluefors becomes a member of the Chicago Quantum Exchange and opens a Bluefors Lab Service facility within the UChicago Science Incubator at Hyde Park Labs on 12 May 2026, giving early-stage startups and researchers flexible access to an LD400He cryogenic measurement system.
